title: LOTUSim: Multi-Domain Simulator for Marine Robotics
venue: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
abstract: Simulation is essential for maritime robotics, supporting operator training, mission rehearsal, and human-vehicle interaction in environments where real-world testing is costly or hazardous. LOTUSim is an open-source, real-time maritime simulator supporting multi-user interaction across aerial, surface, and underwater robotic systems for coordinated naval-style operations, combining real-time interactive performance at scale with an Ekman-inspired underwater current model validated against ocean reanalysis data.
